Grupo Pochteca SAB de CV Launches New Eco-Friendly Solvent Product Line in Mexico

Grupo Pochteca SAB de CV, a leading player in Mexico’s chemicals industry, announced the launch of a new line of eco-friendly solvents aimed at meeting growing demand for sustainable industrial solutions. The launch event, held at the company’s Mexico City headquarters on Wednesday, was attended by company executives, industry analysts, and representatives from the National Association of Chemical Distributors.

According to Pochteca’s Chief Executive Officer, Laura García, the new product line, branded as VerdeSolv, utilizes plant-based raw materials and advanced processing technologies to reduce volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions. “With VerdeSolv, we are not only responding to customer demand for greener alternatives, but also advancing our commitment to environmental stewardship,” García said. She noted that the solvents are designed for use in industries such as coatings, adhesives, and cleaning, with initial distribution focused on the Bajío and northern regions.

Industry observers welcomed the development. “Sustainability is becoming a core consideration in supply chains, especially in chemicals,” said Esteban Ruiz, an analyst at Mercado Research. “Pochteca is positioning itself well by innovating in this segment.”

The launch comes as Mexican regulators have been encouraging manufacturers to adopt cleaner technologies. According to the Mexican Chemical Industry Chamber, demand for eco-friendly solvents has grown by 12% annually over the past three years.

Grupo Pochteca SAB de CV plans to expand VerdeSolv’s production capacity by 20% over the next two years, and the company expects the product line to represent 10% of total solvent sales by 2026. “We believe this is just the beginning of a larger shift toward sustainable chemistry in Mexico,” García stated.
